tui.tooSmall: The window is too small ({cw}×{ch}). Please enlarge the terminal to at least {w}×{h}.

help.title: Keyboard & mouse
help.focus: Move between fields, buttons and lists
help.arrows: Move inside lists; between buttons elsewhere
help.activate: Press the focused button, toggle a checkbox, pick a list entry
help.back: Close a dialog or go back one step
help.scroll: Scroll long pages and the output log
help.editing: Text fields: start/end, delete to start/end, delete word
help.select: Depot selection: select all / none, filter, start download
help.history: History: resume, download again, update, open folder, edit emulator, remove
help.quit: Quit (asks first while a download runs)
help.mouse: Everything is clickable: buttons, tabs, list rows (double-click opens), checkboxes. The mouse wheel scrolls lists and pages.
help.drop: Drag a .lua or .st file onto the terminal window — most terminals paste its path, which loads the file right away.

upload.dropHint: or type/paste its path below and press Enter.

search.invalidAppId: Please enter a valid App ID, or pick a game from the suggestions.
search.sourcesNote: {count} depot source(s) configured. Manage them in Settings (F4).

select.updateNotice: Update mode: the download goes into {path}. Only changed files are downloaded, files removed from the game are deleted, depots that are already up to date are skipped.
select.customManifestPlaceholder: Leave empty for the manifest above
select.engineNative: Engine: native Steam downloader (change in Settings → Downloads).

progress.manifestHub: Downloading custom manifest for depot {depot} via ManifestHub…
progress.manifestHubLine: Downloading custom manifest for depot {depot} (ID {id}) via ManifestHub…
progress.diskLow: Free disk space: {free} GB on {drive} — low
progress.diskCritical: Free disk space: {free} GB on {drive} — critically low!
progress.nativeNote: Native downloader (alpha) — if something fails, copy the output and open an issue on GitHub.
progress.noLongerRunning: The job is no longer running.
progress.ended: The download ended. You can start over.

shortcut.pickLocation: Select at least one shortcut location.

emu.achievementWatcher: Tip: Achievement Watcher shows a notification when you unlock an achievement in an emulated game (Windows). Original: github.com/xan105/Achievement-Watcher — maintained fork: github.com/darktakayanagi/Achievement-Watcher

history.filterPlaceholder: Game name, App ID or status…
history.empty: No downloads yet. Your download history will appear here.

settings.languageHint: Applies immediately; the desktop app picks it up on its next start.
settings.noTruecolor: This terminal doesn't report 24-bit color, so the terminal palette is used.
settings.noColor: NO_COLOR is set, colors are disabled.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Checks GitHub for a new release on startup.
settings.mhStoredLocally: The ManifestHub key is stored for the terminal app only (the desktop app keeps its own).
settings.dataDir: Data directory (shared with the desktop app)
settings.stderrLog: Diagnostic output of the terminal app
settings.dataDirHint: Use --data-dir or {env} to point the app somewhere else (portable or container setups).
settings.copied: Debug info copied to the clipboard.
